statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-23949 affects jaraco.context tarball extraction through tarball() and strip_first_component(). Emissary 3.10 receives jaraco.context 5.3.0 only as a dependency vendored inside setuptools; Emissary does not import jaraco.context or call the affected archive extraction APIs, and setuptools maintainers confirm setuptools does not exercise the vulnerable behavior.
